e-polls.1.evidence: Browser, bob: General Discussion composer > Add Poll, question 'Which day suits the monthly community call?', three options, Single choice, Post Topic -> topic publishes and the poll shows all three options (0%, 0 voters)

e-polls.2.evidence: Browser: question plus one filled option and one blank -> modal 'Question and at least 2 options required.', stays on /new/, no topic created (the button is labelled Post Topic, not Create Poll)

e-polls.3.evidence: bob POST /posts/{id}/poll: blank option -> 400 "A poll requires at least 2 non-empty options."; 501-char question -> 400 "Poll question must be 500 characters or fewer."; 256-char option -> 400 "Poll option must be 255 characters or fewer."; closes_at "notadate" -> 400 "Invalid close date format."

e-polls.4.evidence: second POST on the same topic -> 409 jetonomy_duplicate "This topic already has a poll."

e-polls.5.evidence: REST: alice vote on Thursday -> total_voters 1, option count 1 (UI marking of her choice not viewed)

e-polls.6.evidence: REST: alice then voted Saturday -> Thursday 0, Saturday 1, total_voters stays 1

e-polls.7.evidence: alice DELETE /polls/{id}/vote -> 200 all counts 0, total_voters 0; second DELETE -> 404 "No vote found to remove."

e-polls.8.evidence: Browser, maya on a Multiple choice poll: ticking Alpha then Beta votes instantly (Alpha 100%, then Alpha 50% / Beta 50%, persists after reload); unticking both returns to 0 voters, never negative. There is no submit button, each tick saves

e-polls.9.evidence: maya single-choice vote with two option_ids -> 400 "This poll allows only one choice."; option id 1 from another poll -> 400 "Option 1 does not belong to this poll."; empty option_ids -> 400 "At least one option is required."

e-polls.10.evidence: Browser: double-click on an option -> count 1 (Thursday 100%); lena voting the same option from two tabs at once -> 2 voters total, Tuesday 50% / Thursday 50%, sum 100

e-polls.11.evidence: set closes_at in the past on the poll: maya vote -> 403 jetonomy_closed "This poll has closed."; alice DELETE vote -> 403 "This poll has closed. Votes cannot be changed." (REST status is 403, matches the runbook alternative); results still returned

e-polls.12.evidence: Re-read line, bob as topic author: PATCH /polls/{id} closes_at 2020-01-01 -> response closed:true and the page shows closed on reload; closes_at null -> closed:false; PATCH body {closed:true} alone changes nothing (closed stays false)

e-polls.13.evidence: alice PATCH bob's poll -> 403 "You do not have permission to modify this poll."; alice POST a poll on bob's topic -> 403 "You do not have permission to create a poll on this topic." (wording says "topic", runbook says "post"); moderator/space_admin success not walked

e-polls.15.evidence: poll in private Customer Advisory Board: bob vote -> 404 jetonomy_not_found "Poll not found." identical to a nonexistent poll id (99999); guest GET -> 404 rest_no_route; (v2.0.7 privacy follow-through holds for vote)

e-polls.16.evidence: finn (silenced) POST vote -> 403 jetonomy_user_silenced "Your account is currently silenced and cannot post."

e-polls.17.evidence: omar (space_ban on Off-Topic Lounge) vote on a poll in that space -> 404 "Poll not found." (refused, hidden like a missing poll); vote count unchanged at 0

e-polls.19.evidence: wp-admin Jetonomy > Polls lists Question and Topic columns with real topic titles (e.g. "How important is dark mode to you?" with its topic); deleted-topic placeholder and paging not walked
